iit-msf.tuitionLabel: Estimated tuition — 30 credits × $1,925/credit (Stuart School of Business 2026–27)
iit-msf.feesNote: Mandatory (2026–27 Stuart schedule): Activity Fee FT grad $125/semester; Student Service Fee new FT (entering Summer 2023+) $800 one-time; Opt-in U-Pass $155/semester; Health Insurance $2,510/year (billed Fall; waivable with comparable coverage). App fee $100; deposit $300. Semester count depends on FT pace (typically 12–15 months) — do not invent multi-semester fee total.
iit-msf.notes: STEM-designated MS Finance; ≥30 semester credit hours; F-1 eligible. Open external admits (AMP Plus One is Illinois Tech undergrad pathway, not a restriction on external MS admits). Fall 2027 priorities Jan 31 / Apr 15; intl outside US regular Jun 15. Same per-credit rate domestic/intl.
iit-msf.startTerm: Fall 2027 (also Spring; university calendar lists Summer — confirm Stuart MSF summer admits)
iit-msf.summerStartNote: University graduate calendar lists Summer term; Stuart MSF summer admits not confirmed on program page this pass.

temple-msf.tuitionLabel: Estimated tuition — 30 credits × $1,165/credit (Fox specialized master’s 2026–27; PA and OOS same)
temple-msf.feesNote: One-time program fee $750 in term of admission (Graduate Bulletin footnote for Fox specialized master’s / MBA). Living separate.
temple-msf.period: 2026–27 credit rate (Temple Graduate Bulletin Cost and Aid)
temple-msf.notes: Official title Master of Science in Financial Analysis (STEM) — TFE lists Temple MS Finance. Full-time 10 or 22 months; part-time ~2 years. August Finance Academy precedes fall modules. Open external/intl admits. Program marketing also listed $1,165 for 2025–26; bulletin 2026–27 confirms same specialized-master rate.
temple-msf.startTerm: Fall 2027 (Finance Academy in August precedes fall modules)

lsu-msf.tuitionEstimateLabel: Estimate only (NOT a published flat sticker): non-resident Tier 2 tuition+mandatory fees for 36 credits paced 12+12+12 as Fall 2026 $15,441.15 + Spring 2027 $15,429.15 + third major-term 12h using Fall 2026 NR Tier 2 $15,441.15 ≈ $46,311. Third Fall 2027 rate not published — proxy. Alternative Summer 2027 12h NR $9,843.25 (summer schedule is untiered) would yield ≈ $40,714 for Fall+Spring+Summer — pacing not locked on department page.
lsu-msf.feesNote: LSU graduate schedules already include mandatory fees in the published hour totals. No separate MSF program fee listed (MBA/DMAE professional fees do not apply to MS Finance).
lsu-msf.period: 2026–27 graduate tuition schedule (no flat MSF sticker)
lsu-msf.notes: On-campus Ourso MS Finance: 36-hour full-time three-semester program; Fall and Spring admits. Finance is Tier 2 differential tuition (LSU Differential Tuition FAQ). Separate LSU Online MS Finance ($970/cr × 36 = $34,920 marketed) is a different modality — out of this id’s primary sticker. Department page: We currently do not offer any assistantships for the masters program for the coming academic year. STEM not stated on MS Finance page (stem null). Open external admits (Accelerated BS/MS is undergrad path, not a restriction).

santaclara-msf.tuitionLabel: Estimated tuition — 36 units × $1,581/unit (MSFA 2026–27 on program page)
santaclara-msf.feesNote: Enrollment deposit MSFA $1,000 (credited to first-quarter tuition). Graduate Business Student Association Fee $50/quarter appears on Leavey bulletin financial info (2025–26 bulletin listed MSFA at prior $1,520/unit — use live program page $1,581 for 2026–27). Health insurance TBD / separate.
santaclara-msf.notes: Official title MS in Finance & Analytics (MSFA). On-campus STEM / F-1 eligible; Online MSFA is NOT STEM and NOT F-1 eligible — use on-campus path for intl. ~9 months FT / ~16 months PT. Fall mid-September and Spring late March/early April starts for on-campus.
santaclara-msf.stemNote: On-ground MSFA only; Online MSFA not STEM per Leavey FAQ.

rit-msf.feesNote: When FT (9+ credits/sem): Student Activity Fee $235/sem + Student Health Services Fee $315/sem. International students automatically enrolled/billed for RIT health insurance (amount not on estimate page this pass). No Finance MS flat total published.
rit-msf.notes: RIT graduate billing 2026–27: $2,690/credit if <12 credits/sem OR fixed $32,271/sem for 12–18 credits. Finance MS total credit hours NOT stated on rit.edu/study/finance-ms this pass (secondary sources cite 31 — left null). On-campus only; Fall or Spring; STEM-OPT eligible for full-time. Open external admits. Use RIT estimate tool once plan of study / credits confirmed.

livingCostBand.basis: RIT Estimate Graduate Education Costs page (linked from Finance MS): estimated living expenses (housing and meals) $17,370/year + estimated transportation, books, supplies, and personal expenses $3,016/year = $20,386. General graduate estimate — not a Finance-MS-only COA table.

arizona-msf.tuitionLabel: Non-resident tuition — Tucson on-campus MS Finance 9-month / 30 units (Eller Matrix 2026–27)
arizona-msf.feesNote: Matrix footnote: tuition and fees subject to change. ROI page itemizes AZ resident 9-mo total $27,122 and Non-AZ $47,422 (slightly below matrix round numbers) including program fees/fees lines; $500 seat fee due after admission applied toward tuition if student attends. FINPrep non-credit summer module $2,500 separate if required. Online MSF listed separately $37,500 ($1,250/unit) — different modality.
arizona-msf.period: 2026–27 (Eller graduate programs matrix PDF dated Aug 2026)
arizona-msf.notes: STEM; ~9 months Tucson on-campus; 30 units. Open external/intl. Prefer matrix sticker ($47,500 NR / $27,200 AZ) as official 2026–27 program matrix; ROI page itemization differs by ~$78.

chicago-booth-mif.tuitionLabel: Total tuition four-quarter program — Autumn 2026 matriculants (proxy for Autumn 2027 until updated)

Full tuition charged over four quarterly installments. Books $549 in 3-quarter COA. Health insurance allowance embedded in Misc. Personal Expenses; university health rates TBD on page.
chicago-booth-mif.period: 2026/27 (Autumn 2026 matriculant totals on Booth MiF Cost page)
chicago-booth-mif.notes: Asness and Liew Master in Finance (MiF); STEM-eligible for OPT (FAQ); 15 months / four quarters; summer internship after first three quarters. Accelerated 10-month track discontinued. Autumn 2027 cohort rates may change — confirm when updated. Locked add (no TFE 2026 rank).

livingCostBand.basis: Booth MiF 2026/27 Estimated COA (Three Quarters): Housing and Food $26,010 + Misc. Personal Expenses $7,770 + Transportation $1,800 = $35,580. Fourth quarter / internship summer living not separately itemized on page.

columbia-msfe.tuitionLabel: Estimated total tuition two years — $77,516/year × 2 (MSFE Student Budget 2026–27)
columbia-msfe.feesNote: Mandatory fees Year 1 $5,811 + Year 2 $5,706 = $11,517 (University services & support, program, health services, and Y1 one-time document fee components per page footnotes). Health Insurance $5,823/year separate in budget table.
columbia-msfe.period: 2026–27 indexed MSFE budgets on CBS MS Programs costs page
columbia-msfe.notes: MS in Financial Economics (MSFE); STEM-eligible; four fall/spring semesters; min 48 credits / max 52.5 under flat rate; begins late August; typical ≥6-week summer internship. Live costs page Cloudflare-blocked to direct curl; figures verified via jina.ai fetch of the same official URL showing Student Budget 2026–27 Year 1/2 tables ($77,516 tuition each year). Wayback Apr 2026 still showed prior 2025–26 MSFE $75,256 — live updated. Tuition generally increases 2–7% noted on page — Fall 2027 entrants’ Year 2 may differ. Locked add (no TFE 2026 rank).

livingCostBand.basis: MSFE Student Budget 2026–27 (per year): Food & Housing $30,231 + Personal Expenses $3,636 + Transportation $1,359 = $35,226 (excludes books $1,290 and health insurance $5,823). Same living lines Year 1 and Year 2.
